name: bean-counter
description: Command index. Every command runs from the repository root; this file knows which project each one belongs to. It has no dependencies and nothing is installed here — the two projects underneath own their own toolchains.

scripts.bootstrap: cd frontend && pnpm install && cd ../backend && uv sync
scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; pnpm run dev:backend & pnpm run dev:frontend & wait
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
